texts_example: Margherita Classica. San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella di bufala, fragrant basil leaves, and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil. Pizza main (vegetarian). classic, vegetarian, simple. From Forno Rosso.
Diavola Piccante. Spicy salami, tomato base, mozzarella, and a hint of chili flakes for those who crave a bold, fiery kick. Pizza main (spicy). spicy, meaty, popular. From Forno Rosso.

Quattro Formaggi. A rich blend of mozzarella, gorgonzola, parmesan, and creamy goat cheese melted perfectly on our signature crispy crust base. Pizza main (vegetarian). cheesy, vegetarian, rich. From Forno Rosso.
